data.desc: Betterware de Mexico SAPI de CV (NYSE: BWMX) also referred to as'BeFra' is one of the leading branded consumer products platforms in Mexico and Latin America, bringing together three iconic brands: Betterware, a leader in innovative home solutions; Jafra, a leading beauty and personal care company with operations in Mexico and the United States ; and Tupperware, a leading brand in food storage and drinkware. Through these brands, BeFra operates across Mexico, Brazil, the United States, and an expanding footprint throughout Latin America, leveraging proprietary direct-selling platforms, world-class manufacturing capabilities, and a longstanding culture of operational excellence.
